title: Food gap: gather or hunt while crops grow
applies_when: Stored food may run out before the first harvest.
approach: Harvest ripe nearby berries or other edible wild plants. Compare ready food with the actual time until crops mature; a growing zone does not feed anyone today.
For hunting, choose reachable animals with low observed revenge risk. Use a capable hunter with a ranged weapon, then arrange corpse storage, butchering and cooking.
Do not assume a larger animal is a better target: injury, herd retaliation and hauling distance can outweigh its meat yield.
If local fishing is supported, compare its observed output and labor with these options; this guide does not establish fishing availability or yield.
verify: Animal revenge risk, route hazards, edible products and ability to process the carcass.
reconsider: Predators, insects, winter migration or depleted forage make the source unreliable.
